#264 · Rushing Pokémon

Linoone

Normal

Hoenn · Generation 3

Linoone is a Normal-type Rushing Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 0.5 m tall and weighs 32.5 kg. It evolves from Zigzagoon and into Obstagoon. Its highest base stat is Speed (100), with a base stat total of 420.
